text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #163336

g.text: F09 / Continuation states and finite stopping

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52666a

g.text: An open question does not automatically require a new experiment.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #007c83
font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #163336

g.text: R18 keyed count; R30 historical repairs; R31 observer.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #163336

g.text: Reopen on a concrete contradiction, error or selected stronger claim.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #98611a
font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #163336

g.text: R32 clean exporter source; stronger field claim excluded.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #163336

g.text: Retain the observation; recover source only if a new claim needs it.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #68568d
font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #163336

g.text: R22 output-changing coupling; R33 population calibration.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #163336

g.text: Choose a specific estimand and finite protocol before new work.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #176da5
font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #163336

g.text: R36 overlooked records; R35 dated knowledge states.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #163336

g.text: Inspect existing archives and reconcile conflicts before collecting.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52666a
font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #163336

g.text: R37: U-01 to U-06 ask what registered explanations omit.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #163336

g.text: A probe is a search question, not a measured hidden phenomenon.
Select a claim -> define a discriminating observation -> fix a stop rule.
Unavailable evidence, a negative result and abstention are legitimate endpoints.
